description.en: Read-only page structure reader for DSH. Returns table coordinates, shadow DOM fields, code blocks, and confidence labels; attaches to the CUA browser. Published on npm as dsh-page-struct.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的只读页面结构读取器。返回表格坐标、shadow DOM 字段、代码块与可信度标注，依附 CUA 浏览器工作。已发布到 npm：dsh-page-struct。
